integrity: The local obstruction is derived exactly from the published squarefree formula for the Gaussian Euler function. The asymptotic is obtained by fixed-modulus prime number theory plus a uniform Brun--Titchmarsh tail and an elementary large-small-prime split. Finite computations are corroborative and are not used to infer an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only odd squarefree semiprimes. It does not determine the density of G-cyclic integers in the full integers and does not settle the Gaussian-Carmichael-multiple question for G-cyclic numbers. The analytic argument uses the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions, Brun--Titchmarsh, and Landau's semiprime theorem as established inputs.
title: Exceptional asymptotic for Gaussian-cyclic semiprimes
